flows.name: Redstone Tablet Setup
flows.description: Actions for provisioning and maintaining Peloton Redstone design review tablets

steps.title: Install Apps
steps.description: Choose one or more APK files to install on the connected tablet.

steps.title: Take Screenshot
steps.description: Capture the tablet's current screen and save it to /tmp/ on your Mac.

commands.label: Capture screen
commands.shell: adb exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/redstone-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).png && echo 'Screenshot saved to /tmp/'

steps.title: Configure Display
steps.description: Set display density and font scale optimized for design review, and reduce animations for cleaner screenshots.

commands.label: Set font scale to 1.0
commands.shell: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0

commands.label: Reduce animations
commands.shell: adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0.5 && adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0.5 && adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0.5

steps.title: Enable Debug Overlays
steps.description: Enable layout bounds, pointer location, and other debug overlays useful for design QA.

commands.label: Enable pointer location
commands.shell: adb shell settings put system pointer_location 0

steps.title: Reset Display
steps.description: Restore the tablet's default display density, font scale, and animation speeds.
steps.confirmMessage: This will revert the tablet's display density, font scale, and animation speeds to their defaults.

commands.label: Reset font scale
commands.shell: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0

commands.label: Restore animations
commands.shell: adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 1.0 && adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 1.0 && adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 1.0

steps.title: Push Design Config
steps.description: Create the Redstone design review configuration directory on the tablet.
steps.confirmMessage: This will create the Redstone design review configuration directory on the connected tablet.
